patch_description: Keeps the current program’s direct-link rewards, pressure-aware two-hop routing, mean-field correction, and sparse redundancy penalties, which together give strong sampling and post-processing results. It adds a restrained version of the inspiration program’s small-cut signal: reciprocal-link couplings and centered linear corrections provide a congestion cue without letting that extra signal dominate the existing path terms. The implementation also validates and sanitizes the demand matrix, while preserving the required return format and adaptive degree-penalty weight.
